notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

school.missingBody: This school does not exist or you no longer have access to it.

suspended.title: This school is suspended
suspended.body: A Sathiya super admin has suspended this school, so its timetables and settings can't be opened right now. If you think this is a mistake, contact the Sathiya team.
suspended.writeBlocked: This school is suspended, so changes can't be saved.

phoneNotice.title: Best on a bigger screen
phoneNotice.body: Sathiya's admin screens work best on a laptop, desktop or tablet. You can continue, but some screens may be hard to use on a phone.
phoneNotice.banner: Admin screens work best on a laptop, desktop or tablet.

review.bannerBody: Some features are not available until Sathiya approves it.
review.locked: Available after Sathiya approves your school.
review.teachersCantJoin: Available after Sathiya approves your school. Teachers can't join yet.
review.personalLinks: Personal links are available after Sathiya approves your school.

notApproved.title: {{name}} was not approved
notApproved.body: Sathiya reviewed your registration and could not approve it. Your school can't be used until this is sorted out.
notApproved.bodyDate: Sathiya reviewed your registration on {{date}} and could not approve it. Your school can't be used until this is sorted out.
notApproved.contactBody: Send what the reason asks for, or tell us why you think this is a mistake. We'll review it again.
notApproved.removeBody: Deletes the school and everything set up in it, so the school can be registered again.
notApproved.confirmBody: This deletes the school with its teachers, subjects, classes and the draft timetable. It cannot be undone.
notApproved.failed: Could not remove the registration. Try again.
notApproved.teacherBody: This school isn't active on Sathiya yet. Ask your school admin.
